scene.note: Python reads night_report.py and either prints the report for the next shift or stops with a traceback that says where to look.

steps.note: Rhona runs the night report and gets an error instead of the callouts.
Python reads the whole file first, and one line under Task 1 cannot be read.
The error names the line and the kind of mistake, so nothing else in the file has run.
Once Python can read the line, the callouts print again.
With Task 1 fixed, Python reads further and stops at the line under Task 2.
This time the complaint is about where the line starts, not about its words.
Once that line can be read too, the hours print again.
Now the whole file can be read, so Python runs it from the top.
The callouts and the hours print, then one line stops everything.
Read from the bottom, the traceback names a variable nobody made.
Once Python knows the name on that line, the kit officer prints.
The last line joins words and a number.
The traceback says which two kinds of value met.
Once the two kinds of value can go together, the whole report reaches the next shift.
